tei:div.tei:p: ༁ྃ: zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: las byang rtsa phreng tshor ba rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

:t+ya/mat+ya/: kun bzang che mchog zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang : dam pa rigs brgya 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la: gus pas phyag 'tshal rang rig grol nas kyang : 'gro kun sku gsum don la gnas gyur cig: bdag 'dra o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas: skal ldan skyes bu las can rnams kyi don: bde gshegs zhi khro 'dus pa'i las byang bstan: 'di ltar nyams su longs shig rigs kyi bu: shāt+ya/ny+rakyath+yath+ya: 'di la spyi don bco brgyad bstan: bka' bsgo mtshams gcod phyag rgya bzung : sngon 'gro yan lag bcu pa dang : sman raka gtor gsum byin brlab dang : gzhal yas khog dbub lha bskyed dang : spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal zhing : mchod gtor bstod bshags tshogs las bya: bskul dang chad mdo sgo dbye dang : gtor skyong gtor bro smon lam gdab: le'u bco brgyad las byang grangs: skal ldan rnams kyis nyams su longs: byata/ma/: dang po bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐: nga nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: 'od dang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad kun: rang rig stong gsal rig pa'i mdangs: kun bzang rigs lnga rdo rje sems: snang la rang bzhin med pa yis: rab tu gang nas 'od 'phros pas: lus ngag sems la gnod byed cing : mchod pa'i mdangs 'phrog ma rig bgegs: nyon mongs ma rig rgyu las byung : rgyu drug 'khor ba'i lam dgag phyir: 'di ru ma 'dug rang sar dengs: hūm̐ hūm̐ u tsa ta ya phaṭa: gnyis pa mtshams gcod 'di skad do: hūm̐: rang rig rdo rje sems dpa' ste: dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku: gzi brjid ldan pa'i thugs ka ru: drag po'i byin rlabs rig rtsal las: gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin: sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur zhing : gdug pa 'dul bar rab bsngags pas: thugs kyi sprul pas stong gsum khyab: de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer tshul: hūm̐ 'phros shar phyogs rdo rjes gtams: traṃ 'phros lho phyogs rin chen gtams:

hrīḥ'aphros nub phyogs pad+mas gtams: āḥ'aphros byang phyogs rgya gram gtams: oṃ 'phros steng phyogs 'khor los gtams: ram̐ 'phros phyi rol me dpung 'bar: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : rgya gram 'khor lo me ri'i gur: rim pa drug gi tshul du bskor: bskal pa stongs kyang mi 'jigs cing : 'byung ba'i gnod pas tshugs mi 'gyur: khro tshogs sprul pa dpag med kyis: rab tu gtams shing mtshams bcad do: oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥ ram̐ hūm̐ bh+ruṃ dhi ram̐: badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: gsum pa phyag rgya bzung ba ni: rdo rje g.yas la dril bu g.yon: lag tu thogs la 'di skad do: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye ba med pa las: ma 'gags thabs shes brda mtshon phyir: rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol: 'gro ba sems can thams cad kun: sad nas sangs rgyas sar 'jug phyir: yang dag nyid du brdas mtshon no: zung 'jug lam la ma brten par: mthar phyin 'bras bu thob mi srid: thabs shes yang dag nyid la 'jug: badz+ra ghan+dhe dharma hūm̐ āḥ bzhi pa yan lag bcu pa ni: tshogs zhing nam mkhar dmigs byas la: oṃ āḥhūm̐: nam mkha'i mthar thug zhing khams rab 'byams na: bde gshegs rgya mtsho zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkon mchog rin chen gsum dang yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dam can tshogs bcas la: deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar: 'bral ba med par gus pas skyabs su mchi: skyabs su 'gro ba'i yan lag go: chos nyid dbyings kyi rab 'byams klong yangs nas: shes rab thabs dang thugs rjes skur sprul pa: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i zhi khro rab 'byams rnams: gnas 'dir 'gro ba'i don du gshegs su gsol: spyan 'dren pa'i yan lag go: snang srid rnam dag ye shes dkyil 'khor 'dir: rin chen seng ge la sogs khri steng du: thabs shes dri med nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : zag med dgyes pa chen por bzhugs su gsol: bzhugs su gsol ba'i yan lag go:

kun tu bzang mo gsang ba'i bha ga ru: kun tu bzang po zag pa med pas bde: rol pa ye shes rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: yab yum sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo: phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag go: bde gshegs zhi khro rgyal ba rgya mtsho la: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dpag med rnams: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul te: 'gro ba'i don du 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol: mchod pa 'bul ba'i yan lag go: thog med dus nas dug gsum dbang gyur te: sgo gsum sdig sgrib bag chags bcas pa rnams: ngan song 'khor ba'i rgyu bsags thams cad kun: rab tu gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags: sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag go: chos dbyings kun khyab snang srid bde chen zhing : 'gro don mdzad dang bsod nams byang chub sems: bsod nams ye shes don 'byung thams cad la: dga' ba chen pos rjes su yi rang ngo : rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag go: phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rdul snyed ston pa rnams: sems can don du thugs dam rgyud bskul te: nam mkha'i mthar thug dbyangs kyis rab gang ba'i: chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor bar bskul: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i yan lag go: ji srid 'khor ba'i 'jig rten ma stongs bar: de srid 'gro ba rgya chen don byed cing : mtha' yas sangs rgyas ston pa ma lus kun: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa'i yan lag go: bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa: nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can kun: bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur nas: zhi khro rab 'byams go 'phang myur thob shog: bla med theg pa chen por bsngo ba'i yan lag go: lnga pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: gyer sgom dal bar 'di skad do: hūm̐: dmigs bsam brjod bral ngang nyid las: thams cad stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid: sman raka gtor mchod dngos po rnams: stong nyid bdag 'dzin bral ba las:

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gsum me rlung chus: bdag 'dzin rtog pa'i dri ma sbyangs: me rlung chu yang 'od du zhu: sman raka gtor mchod dngos por gyur: rtog gnyis dag nas snod bcud rnams: 'dod pa'i yon tan du mar gyur: bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: dpa' bo 'bru lngas rgyu byas nas: dpa' mo 'bru lngas rkyen byas te: thabs shes gnyis med bdud rtsi'i chu: sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor ba'i: dkar dmar mthing gsum bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ rak+ta byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum: dug gsum stong gsal ma 'gags mdangs: rgyu rkyen rnam dag rak+ta 'khyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes lngar bsgral ba'i: sha chen lnga yi brda bstan gtor chen po: ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin rnam par dag: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: phyi mchod 'dod yon rnam lngar byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: gnas su dag phyir yul snang rnam par dag: me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab bshos: gnas yul rnam dag mchod pa chen po'o: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐: zhes pas gyer sgom dal bar bya'o: zhi khro 'dus pa'i las byang tshor ba rang grol gyi sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhi khro 'dus pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: drug pa zhi khro'i bsgom khog ni: thog mar ting 'dzin rnam gsum las: dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa ni:

gyer bsgom ldan pas 'di skad do: oṃ: rnam par rtog gsum bral ba yi: dmigs med brjod bral de bzhin nyid: ma hā shu n+ya ta dzña na sa ma ti āḥ gnyis pa kun snang gi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa ni: āḥ rtog bral ngang las rang byung rtsal: stong nyid snying rje kun tu snang : badz+ra ma hā ka ru ṇi ka sa ma ti āḥ gsum pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: gsal stong snying rje'i ngang nyid las: rang sems rig rtsal 'gag med 'di: mthing nag rgyu yi yi ge aḥ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐ āḥ bzhi pa 'byung ba rim brtsegs bsgom pa ni: stong gsal rang bab gdos bcas bral: snang la rang bzhin ma grub par: nam mkha'i gzugs can 'od zer 'phro: a las 'od zer e ru chad: e las chos 'byung zur drug ldan: de steng a las yam̐ 'phros pas: ye shes lnga ldan rgya gram rlung : dkar ser dmar ljang mthing kha'i mdog: chos sku'i rang rtsal shugs ldan gnas: de steng a las bam̐ 'phros pas: bam̐ las ye shes 'byung ba chu: bcud ldan shin tu gzugs mdzes pa: kha dog ma nges rgya mtshor 'khyil: lam̐ 'phros rin chen sa gzhir brdal: gser g.yu mu tig zangs lcags tshogs: zur bzhi logs brgyad khri rkang dang : rin chen lnga yi ri rab brtsegs: a las bh+rum̐ 'phros gzhal yas khang : rat+na lnga las grub pa yi: zur bzhi logs bzhi sgo bzhir ldan: lha chen brgyad kyi ka gdung byas: lha bran dral phyam rin chen thog: rus sbal chu srin ka ba'i gdan: mu tig 'od phreng rin chen brgyan: gza' brgyad ka zhu rgyu skar 'degs: pha gu rin chen mig tshags phreng : dril bu rtsa brgyad mchod rten bskor: mi nub rgyal mtshan bcu yis brgyan: ri dwags chos nyan chos 'khor ldan: gdugs dang dar dpyangs bkra shis rdzas: phyi rim dur khrod gnas brgyad dang : rdo rje mtshon cha me ris bskor: stong pa'i dbyings su 'ja' ltar shar: phyi dang nang med zang thal gsal: yid 'ong mdzes ldan gzhal yas khang :

rgyal ba zhi khro'i bzhugs gnas so: bh+rum̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe dzña na tsakra bh+rum̐: a e yam̐ bam̐ lam̐ bh+rum̐: bi shwa bi shud+dhe āḥ bh+rum̐ hūm̐: bh+rum̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: lnga pa lha tshogs 'khor bcas bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid tha mal rang sems 'di: rtog pas ma chod so ma'i ngang : bsam bral ngang las sems yid 'di: rdo rje mthing nag a yis mtshan: rdo rje ar bcas 'od zer 'phros: yar mar 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus rdo rje ar bcas pa: 'od zhu ma rig nyon mongs sbyangs: rin chen gzugs sku blugs pa ltar: bdag nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: kun tu bzang po sku mdog mthing : chos nyid bzang mo sku mdog dkar: mnyam bzhag skyil krung gnyis med 'khril: ye shes rin chen sna tshogs khri: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: hūm̐ badz+ra tsit+ta āḥ badz+ra sa man+ta bha dra oṃ: de nas kun bzang yab yum gyi thugs ka nas rnam snang yab yum bskyed pa dang : kun bzang yab yum rnam snang yab yum gyi spyi bor btegs la bzhugs su gsol: de nyid thugs la oṃ lām̐ 'phros: rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad ni: dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas 'khor lo thugs kar 'dzin: g.yon shel dril bu yum la 'khyud: yum mchog dbyings phyug dkar dmar la: cha lugs yab 'dra dgyes par 'khril: seng chen pad nyi rin chen steng : snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: oṃ dzi na dzika: lām̐ te shwa ra ti staṃ: a: kun bzang thugs nas hūm̐ mum̐ 'phros: rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' ni: mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin: g.yon shel dril bu yum la 'khyud: yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan mthing skya: cha lugs yab 'dra dgyes par 'khril: glang chen pad nyi rin chen steng : snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: hūm̐ badz+ra dh+rika: mum̐ dha tu shwa ri s+t+waṃ: thugs kar k+ṣi dang mai 'phros pas: k+ṣi zhu g.yas su sa snying dkar:

myu gu dril 'dzin sems dpa'i skyil: mai zhu g.yon du byams pa dkar: klu shing dril 'dzin sems dpa'i skyil: yum gyi thugs nas hūm̐ hūm̐ 'phros: hūm̐ zhu mdun du lā s+ye dkar: me long gtso bstan phyed skyil bzhugs: hūm̐ zhu rgyab tu puṣ+pe dkar: me tog gtso 'bul phyed skyil bzhugs: rdo rje rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: k+ṣi hi ra tsa ya swā hā: mai tri dha ra ni swā hā: hūm̐ lā s+ye sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: hūm̐ puṣ+pe a we sha ya s+t+waṃ: a: kun bzang thugs nas swa mām̐ 'phros: rang nyid rin chen 'byung ldan ni: ser gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas nor bu thugs kar 'dzin: g.yon pas dril bu yum la 'khyud: yum mchog mā ma ki ser skya: cha lugs yab dang mtshungs par 'khril: rta mchog pad nyi rin chen steng : snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: swa rat+na dh+rikaḥ mām̐ mo ha ra ti s+t+waṃ: yab kyi thugs nas hūm̐ trāṃ 'phros: hūm̐ zhu kun bzang dmar ser g.yas: snye ma dril 'dzin sems dpa'i skyil: trāṃ zhu g.yon du nam snying ser: ral gri dril 'dzin sems dpa'i skyil: yum gyi thugs nas trāṃ dza 'phros: trāṃ zhu mā le ser skya mdun: phreng ba gtso 'bul phyed skyil bzhugs: dza zhu dhu pe ser mo rgyab: spos phor gtso 'bul phyed skyil bzhugs: rin chen rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐ swā ra tsa ya swā hā: trāṃ a gar+bha ya swā hā: trāṃ mā le sa ma ya hoḥ dza dhu pe pra we sha ya s+t+waṃ: a: kun bzang thugs nas aṃ pyaṃ 'phros: bdag nyid snang ba mtha' yas ni: dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas pad+ma thugs kar 'dzin: phyag g.yon dril bu yum la 'khyud: yum mchog gos dkar dmar skya la: rgyan cha yab dang mtshungs par 'khril: rma bya pad nyi rin chen steng : snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: aṃ a ro l̥ka: pyaṃ ra ga ra ti s+t+waṃ:

yab kyi thugs nas hrīḥmum̐ 'phros: hrīḥzhu spyan gzigs dkar dmar g.yas: pad+ma dril 'dzin sems dpa'i skyil: mum̐ zhu 'jam dpal dmar ser g.yon: ut+pal dril 'dzin sems dpa'i skyil: yum gyi thugs nas hrīḥbam̐ 'phros: hrīḥzhu girti dmar skya mdun: pi waṃ sgra sgrogs phyed skyil bzhugs: bam̐ zhu ā lo dmar mo rgyab: mar me gtso 'bul phyed skyil bzhugs: pad+ma rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hrīḥha hūm̐ pad+ma bha ta ma swā hāḥ mūm̐ shrī a raṃ gha ya swā hāḥ hrīḥgirti rā ga ya hoḥ bam̐ dhi pam̐ su ki ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: a: kun bzang thugs nas ha tām̐ 'phros: bdag nyid don yod grub pa ni: ljang gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas rgya gram thugs kar 'dzin: g.yon pas dril bu yum la 'khyud: yum chen sgrol ma ljang skya la: cha lugs yab 'dra dgyes par 'khril: shang shang pad nyi rin chen steng : snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: hā pradzña dhṛka: tām̐ badz+ra ra ti s+t+waṃ: yab kyi thugs nas thiṃlha dzhiṃ 'phros: thiṃlha zhu sgrib sel ljang gu g.yas: pusti dril 'dzin sems dpa'i skyil: dzhiṃ zhu phyag rdor ljang gu g.yon: rdo rje dril 'dzin sems dpa'i skyil: yum gyi thugs nas ho a 'phros: ho zhu ghan+dhe ljang gu mdun: dung phor gtso 'bul phyed skyil bzhugs: a zhu nirti ljang gu rgyab: zhal zas gtso 'bul phyed skyil bzhugs: las kyi rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: thiṃlha sa raṃ pa ya swā hāḥ dzhiṃ ku ru pā ṇi hrīḥswā hāḥ hoḥgan+dhe tsit+ta ya hoḥ a nirti ra ga ya mi s+t+waṃ: zhi ba'i lha tshogs thams cad kyang : dbu rgyan stod g.yogs smad dkris dang : sku rags phyag gdub dpung rgyan mdzes: cod pan snyan cha mgul chun bcas: do shal rin chen phreng bas brgyan: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul can:

gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar: snang la rang bzhin med pa la: 'dzin med ma bcos rang gsal bsgom: a: bdag nyid kun bzang thugs ka nas: kreṃ breṃ truṃ k+ṣaṃ sruṃ ye 'phros: de drug zhu bas thub drug sku: steng du brgya byin pi waṃ dkar: 'og tu chos rgyal me chu nag: shar lhor thags bzang go mtshon ljang : lho nub shāka thub gseg par ser: nub byang seng ge po ti mthing : byang shar kha 'bar sgrom bu dmar: 'gro don mdzad pa'i thub pa drug: pad rkyang steng na bzhengs stabs sku: gsal la 'dzin pa med par bsgom: oṃ mu ne kreṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne breṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne truṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne k+ṣaṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne sruṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne ye swā hā: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: a: bdag nyid kun bzang yab yum gyi: thugs nas sa bon phyogs bzhir 'phros: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ dang : bam̐ ho 'bru brgyad zhu ba las: shar sgor rnam rgyal lcags kyu dkar: lcags kyu dril 'dzin 'dor stabs 'gying : oṃ badz+ra kro ta bi dza ya hūm̐: badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ lho sgor gshin rje zhags pa ser: dbyug to zhags 'dzin 'dor stabs 'gying : oṃ badz+ra kro ta ya man+ta ka hūm̐: badz+ra pa sha hūm̐: nub sgor rta mgrin lcags sgrog dmar: lcags sgrog dril 'dzin 'dor stabs 'gying : oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐: byang sgor bdud rtsi dril bu ljang : rgya gram dril 'dzin 'dor stabs 'gying : oṃ badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li hūm̐: badz+ra ghan+ḍe hoḥ tshad med bzhi ldan yab yum brgyad: thod skam rin chen dbu la brgyan: cod pan snyan cha mgul chun bcas: thod phreng tshar gsum sbrul zhags brgyan: glang chen mi lpags stod g.yogs dang : thal chen tshom bu khrag thig spras: zhag gi zo ris stag lpags dkris: sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung : dgod dang gshe dang rngams par ston: snying rje zhe sdang gtum par bzhugs:

hūm̐: sgyu ma gzugs brnyan chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: 'od zer ye shes lnga ldan gzhal yas khang : seng ge glang chen rta mchog rma bya dang : shang shang rin chen pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : chos sku kun bzang sku gsung thugs yon tan: phrin las lnga yi rig rtsal cho 'phrul las: bcom ldan dpal chen rigs lnga yab yum bcu: sems dpa' sems ma bcu drug 'khor dang bcas: rang snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: sgyu ma gzugs brnyan chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: 'od zer ye shes lnga ldan gzhal yas khang : sna tshogs rin chen nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : kun bzang zhi rgyas dbang drag cho 'phrul las: tshad med bzhi ldan lcags kyu zhags pa dang : lcags sgrol dril bu mu bzhi gnas dag pa'i: rnam thar brgyad ldan sgo ba yab yum brgyad: rang snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: sgyu ma gzugs brnyan chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: 'od zer ye shes lnga ldan gzhal yas khang : rin chen nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i steng : chos sku kun bzang zag med cho 'phrul las: 'gro ba'i rnam rtog rigs drug rtsad gcod phyir: bcom ldan thub drug lha tshogs dpag med 'phros: rang snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: yam̐ bam̐ lam̐ bh+rum̐: rat+na maṇ+ḍa la: pam̐ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: sangs rgyas zhi ba'i lha tshogs bzhi bcu gnyis: rang snang gnas yul dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du: phyogs mtshams rang rang bzhugs pa'i gdan khri la: chu nyid la ni chu nyid thim pa ltar: du ma so sor snang yang ngo bo gcig: gnyis med rang bzhin brtan par bzhugs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: khrag 'thung lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: zhi ba longs sku'i rig rtsal cho 'phrul las: dug lnga 'joms pa'i lha tshogs dpag med 'phros: bcom ldan khrag 'thung che mchog he ru ka: kro ti shwa ri dbyings phyug yum dang 'khril:

sprul pa'i khrag 'thung rigs lnga he ru ka: shes rab dbyings phyug kro ti lnga dang 'khril: yab yum sras dang bka' sdod sprul 'khor bcas: rang snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: khro rgyal sku gsung thugs las sprul pa'i lha: rang snang dbang po tshogs brgyad gnas dag pa'i: kau rī la sogs gnas kyi ma mo brgyad: rang snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: khrag 'thung sku gsung thugs las sprul pa'i lha: rang snang dbang po yul brgyad gnas dag pa'i: sengha la sogs yul gyi phra men brgyad: rang snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: khrag 'thung sku gsung thugs las sprul pa'i lha: dkyil 'khor phyi rim mu ran skyong mdzad ma: sprul pa'i las mdzad dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: rang snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: khrag 'thung rigs bzhi'i thugs las sprul pa'i lha: tshad med bzhi ldan ye shes sgo ma bzhi: phyogs bzhir zhing rkyang rang rang gdan steng du: rang snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: sgyu ma smig rgyu chu zla 'ja' tshon bzhin: rang las byung zhing rang byung rang thim ltar: gnyis med zung 'jug dbyer med chen po ru: du ma ro gcig brtan par bzhugs su gsol: bh+rum̐ e yam̐ bam̐ lam̐ bh+rum̐: rat+na tsakra rat+na ti ra bam̐: pam̐ pad+ma ti ra bam̐: ma sur+ya ti ra bam̐: a tsan+d+ra ti ra bam̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: khatagrata: dgu pa lha la gus phyag 'tshal ba ni: stag chung bung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do: hūm̐: yid shes rnam dag kun tu bzang po yab: chos khams rnam dag kun tu bzang mo yum: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi myes lha: kun bzang yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: gzugs phung rnam dag bcom ldan rnam snang mdzad: rnam shes rnam dag bcom ldan rdo rje sems: tshor ba rnam dag bcom ldan rin chen 'byung :

'du shes rnam dag bcom ldan snang mtha' yas: 'du byed rnam dag bcom ldan don yod grub: phung lnga rnam dag ye shes lnga dang ldan: longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: nam mkha' rnam dag yum mchog dbyings phyug ma: sa khams rnam dag yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan: chu khams rnam dag yum mchog mā ma ki: me khams rnam dag yum mchog na bza' dkar: rlung khams rnam dag yum mchog dam tshig sgrol: khams lnga rnam dag bde chen yab dang sbyor: gsang ba'i yum mchog bde ster rigs lnga la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: tshogs brgyad gnas dag byang chub sems dpa' brgyad: sa snying byams pa kun bzang nam mkha'i snying : spyan gzigs 'jam dpal sgrib sel phyag rdor brgyad: sems dpa'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: nye ba'i sras mchog sems dpa' brgyad rnams la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: yul brgyad gnas dag sems ma chen mo brgyad: lā s+ye puṣ+pe mā le dhu pe ma: girti ā lo gan+dhe nirti brgyad: sems ma'i sar gnas dgyes pa skong mdzad ma: gsang ba'i lha mo sems ma brgyad rnams la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: nyon mongs drug dag rigs drug gnas nas 'dren: brgya byin thags bzang shāka thub seng ge brtan: kha 'bar chos rgyal rigs drug dong nas sprugs: 'gro ba'i don mdzad mdzad pa bsam mi khyab: sprul pa'i sku mchog thub pa drug rnams la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: mu bzhi gnas dag tshad med bzhi dang ldan: rnam rgyal gshin rje rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'khrol ma: sgo ba yab yum brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: t+ya/t+ya/t+ya/: bkasra/: hūm̐: ma rig rtsad gcod che mchog he ru ka: kro ti shwa ri dbyings phyug yum dang sbyor: khrag 'thung che btsan che mchog yab yum la:

gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: gti mug rtsad gcod bud+dha he ru ka: zhe sdang rtsad gcod badz+ra he ru ka: nga rgyal rtsad gcod rat+na he ru ka: 'dod chags rtsad gcod pad+ma he ru ka: phrag dog rtsad gcod karma he ru ka: dbyings kyi yum chen kro ti lnga dang sbyor: khrag 'thung khro bo yab yum bcu rnams la: gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: rnam rtog gzhom phyir khro mo kau rī ma: thabs shes gnyis med khro mo tsau rī ma: 'khor bar mi gtong khro mo pra mo ha: chos nyid 'gyur med khro mo be ta lī: nyon mongs gnas 'dren khro mo puska sī: 'khor ba zhal gsol khro mo ghasma ri: log rtog phral mdzad khro mo tsan+ḍa lī: rten dang phral phyir khro mo sme sha ni: gnas kyi kau ri ma mo brgyad rnams la: gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: 'khor ba ka dag sengha mu kha ma: 'khor ba zhe gnon bya kri mu kha ma: nyon mongs gnas dag sri la mu kha ma: 'khor ba dong sprugs shwa na mu kha ma: dug gsum rtsad gcod kri ta mu kha ma: 'khor ba dang len kaṅka mu kha ma: nyon mongs gsol phyir khwa kha mu kha ma: log rtog phral phyir hu lu mu kha ma: yul bdag sengha phra men brgyad rnams la: gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: snying rjes 'dren phyir rta gdong lcags kyu ma: byams pas 'ching phyir phag gdong zhags pa ma: dga' bas sdom phyir seng gdong lcags sgrog ma: btang snyoms 'bebs phyir sbrul gdong dril bu ma: tshad med bzhi ldan sgo ma bzhi rnams la: gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: dkar mo nyon mongs zhi ba'i las mdzad bdun: ser mo sku gsum rgyas pa'i las mdzad bdun: dmar mo mchog dang thun mong dbang sdud bdun: ljang gu drag po'i phrin las sgrub mdzad bdun: dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad la: gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo:

hūm̐: chos sku nam mkha' lta bur kun la khyab: longs sku nyi 'od lta bur so sor 'phro: sprul sku 'ja' tshon lta bur 'gro don mdzad: rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: t+ya/lkadha/ta/th+ya/: bcu pa phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: dang po phyi mchod rdo rje dril stabs kyis: chu bo'i rgyun dbyangs snyan pos 'di skad do: hūm̐: srid par gtogs pa'i me tog sna tshogs rigs: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing gsal mdangs dang ldan: srid zhi'i 'byor tshogs dpag med me tog kun: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te: bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: snang stong 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐: hūm̐: srid par gtogs pa'i bdug spos sna tshogs rigs: tsan+dan du ru ka dang a ka ru: srid zhi'i 'byor tshogs dpag med ngad ldan spos: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te: bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: tshor stong 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhu pe hūm̐: hūm̐: srid par gtogs pa'i snang gsal sna tshogs rigs: 'bru mar rtsi mar shing ras 'od kyi mdangs: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing gsal mdangs chen 'od: srid zhi'i 'byor tshogs dpag med snang gsal kun: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te: bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: gsal stong 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐: hūm̐: srid par gtogs pa'i dri chab sna tshogs rigs: 'o ma chu sna rtsi dgu sbyar ba'i chu: rang byung rang shar byug pa bde byed tshogs: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te: bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: bde stong 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐: hūm̐: srid par gtogs pa'i zhal zas sna tshogs rigs: rang byung lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i zas:

rtsi bcud zhal zas 'bru sman sna tshogs kun: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te: bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: myong stong 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra nai wi d+yā+e hūm̐: hūm̐: srid par gtogs pa'i rol mo sna tshogs rigs: rnga ting g.yer kha dril bu rdza rnga dung : 'byung lnga'i rang sgra glu gar rol mo dbyangs: dngos 'byor yid sprul dpag med sgra snyan kun: bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: grags stong 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra shap+ta hūm̐: hūm̐: bla ma kun bzang rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: dpag med nam mkha' gang ba'i lha tshogs la: dag pa rnam gsum yid kyi mchod pa'i sprin: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: snang stong rig stong gsal stong bde stong dang : dran stong grags stong tshor stong mchod pa'i tshogs: me tog bdug spos dri zhal rol mor bcas: bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhu pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shap+ta pūts+tsha ho: de nas nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: rol mo sna tshogs sgrogs la 'di skad do: hūm̐: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: lha rdzas nang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: snod bcud snang srid thams cad kun: rdo rje gzugs ma'i tshogs sprul nas: dngos 'byor yid sprul gzugs mchod 'di: kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: oṃ āḥbadz+ra rū pa pra tits+tsha hūm̐: hūm̐: snod bcud snang srid thams cad kun: rdo rje sgra ma'i tshogs sprul nas: dngos 'byor yid sprul sgra mchod 'di: kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: oṃ āḥbadz+ra shap+ta hūm̐: hūm̐: snod bcud snang srid thams cad kun: rdo rje dri ma'i tshogs sprul nas: dngos 'byor yid sprul dri mchod kun:

kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: oṃ āḥbadz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐: hūm̐: snod bcud snang srid thams cad kun: rdo rje ro ma'i tshogs sprul nas: dngos 'byor yid sprul zhal zas kun: kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: oṃ āḥbadz+ra nai wi d+ya hūm̐: hūm̐: snod bcud snang srid thams cad kun: rdo rje reg ma'i tshogs sprul nas: dngos 'byor yid sprul na bza'i tshogs: kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: oṃ āḥbadz+ra spar+she hūm̐: hūm̐: snod bcud snang srid thams cad kun: rdo rje chos ma'i tshogs sprul nas: dngos 'byor yid sprul dpag med kun: kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra dharme hūm̐: de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: pad skor phyag rgya ldan pas 'di skad do: hūm̐: gsang mchog sku yi bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog dkar mdzes me long pad+ma bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang mchog bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra a dar+she hūm̐: hūm̐: gsang mchog gsung gi bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog dmar mdzes rnga zlum sgra sgrogs ma: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang mchog bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra mu rañdze hūm̐: hūm̐: gsang mchog thugs kyi bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog mthing mdzes pi waṃ sgra sgrogs ma: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang mchog bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra wi ni hūm̐: hūm̐: gsang mchog yon tan bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog ser mdzes cang te'u sgra sgrogs ma: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang mchog bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra waṃ se hūm̐: hūm̐: gsang mchog phrin las bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog ljang mdzes rdza rnga'i sgra sgrogs ma:

bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang mchog bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra me dhe ke hūm̐: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bzhi pa sman raka gtor gsum 'bul ba ni: dang po bdud rtsi blangs la 'di skad do: hūm̐: rigs lnga yab yum gnyis kyis rgyu byas te: sku lnga ye shes lnga yis rkyen byas te: thabs shes rgyu la ma 'gag rkyen sbyar ba'i: dam pa rigs brgya'i 'bru bcud bdud rtsi 'di: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐:sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha ram̐ khā hiḥ lha tshogs kun la rkang thon du 'bul bar bya'o: dam pa rigs brgya so so'i mtshan zhabs su a mṛ ta khā hi btags la 'bul: gzhan yang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad la 'bul lo: de nas dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun: mtshan dang ldan pa dbyings kyi bhan+dha ru: ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga'i bdud rtsi 'khyil: snying po med la dngos grub snying po blangs: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: gnyis pa rak+ta blangs la 'di skad do: hūm̐: dug lnga ye shes lnga ru bsgral ba'i khrag: snang stong gsal stong bde stong dran stong dang : gnyis med 'dzin bral gsang ba'i khrag chen 'di: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐:ma hā rak+ta la kha ram̐ khā hiḥ lha tshogs rnams kyi mtshan gyi mthar rak+ta khā hiḥbatags la 'bul lo: gsum pa gtor ma 'bul ba 'di skad do: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gzugs phung rnam dag bhan+dha ru: tshor ba rnam dag gtor chen bshams: 'du shes rnam dag theb kyus bskor: 'du byed rnam dag rgyan gyis brgyan: rnam shes rnam dag gtor chen po: kun bzang chos kyi sku la 'bul: e: stong pa 'gag med bhan+dha ru: gsal ba ye shes gtor ma bshams:

thugs rje lug rgyud gtor rgyan spras: zhi ba longs spyod rdzogs la 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐: phyi snod 'jig rten gtor gzhong du: nang bcud sems can gtor mar bshams: rtsi bcud 'bras bu sman gyis brgyan: zhi khro sprul pa'i sku la 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ma hā ba ling+ta gh+rih+na kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzña na dha tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: e dam ba ling+ta gh+rih+na kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ gzhan yang lha tshogs thams cad kyi mtshan gyi mthar ba liṃ ta khā hi btags la 'bul bar bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bcu gcig pa bstod pa bya ba la bzhi ste: dang po kun tu bzang po'i don bstod ni: chu bo'i nyer dbyangs kyis 'di skad do: oṃ: bla ma kun bzang chos kyi sku: mtshan ma tshig bral zang thal sku: bsam brjod yul 'das kun bzang mo: dug lnga rang grol ye shes sku: nyag gcig mtha' bral lu gu rgyud: kun bzang yab yum sku la bstod: āḥ grags stong rang byung chos kyi gsung : sgra grags stong pa cir mi dgongs: sna tshogs rang grags dmigs gtad bral: rjes su 'dzin pa'i dngos po stong : 'gro 'dul gsung mchog cir yang ston: kun bzang yab yum gsung la bstod: hūm̐: rang rig dran stong gdos bcas bral: sna tshogs shar grol 'gags pa med: dngos med dngos bral gzung yul bral: dgongs pa gnas yul rang sar grol: dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med thugs: kun bzang yab yum thugs la bstod: hrīḥ thams cad ma btsal gzhi la rdzogs: lhun grub 'od gsal 'od dpag med: bsam brjod dpe bral yon tan rdzogs: kun bzang yab yum yon tan rdzogs: hāḥ thugs rje'i rang 'od ye shes rgyas: ma btsal rdzogs ldan thig le'i sku: dpag med phrin las rdzogs pa'i dpal: kun bzang yab yum phrin las bstod: gnyis pa ye shes lnga la bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐: rig pa zang thal 'od kyi sku:

nyag gcig gsal 'tsher lu gu rgyud: 'gyu 'phrig dngos med ngo bo stong : stong pa'i rang bzhin rang 'od gsal: gsal ba'i thugs rje 'gag pa med: zhe sdang rang grol dkar gsal ngang : me long lta bu'i ye shes la: gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ngang nas bstod: hūm̐ swā: rig pa zang thal 'od kyi sku: nyag gcig gsal 'tsher lu gu rgyud: 'gyu 'phrig dngos med ngo bo stong : stong pa'i rang bzhin rang 'od gsal: gsal ba'i thugs rje 'gag pa med: nga rgyal rang grol ser gsal ngang : mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la: gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ngang nas bstod: hūm̐ āṃḥ rig pa zang thal 'od kyi sku: nyag gcig gsal 'tsher lu gu rgyud: 'gyu 'phrig dngos med ngo bo stong : stong pa'i rang bzhin rang 'od gsal: gsal ba'i thugs rje 'gag pa med: 'dod chags rang grol dmar gsal ngang : so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes la: gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ngang nas bstod: hūm̐ hā: rig pa zang thal 'od kyi sku: nyag gcig gsal 'tsher lu gu rgyud: 'gyu 'phrig dngos med ngo bo stong : stong pa'i rang bzhin rang 'od gsal: gsal ba'i thugs rje 'gag pa med: phrag dog rang grol ljang gsal ngang : bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la: gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ngang nas bstod: hūm̐ oṃ: rig pa zang thal 'od kyi sku: nyag gcig gsal 'tsher lu gu rgyud: 'gyu 'phrig dngos med ngo bo stong : stong pa'i rang bzhin rang 'od gsal: gsal ba'i thugs rje 'gag pa med: gti mug rang grol mthing gsal ngang : chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la: gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ngang nas bstod: gsum pa zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis la: dwangs pa'i sems kyis bstod pa bya ba ni: oṃ: gdod nas ma skyes ye nas rnam dag pa'i: kun bzang rig rtsal rdzogs pa'i cho 'phrul las: zhe sdang rnam shes rang grol me long sku: mthing gsal mdangs ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dpal: sna tshogs 'dzin bral rdo rje sems dpar shar: thabs shes gnyis med sa khams spyan mar 'khril:

glang chen khri rkang nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : dug lnga ma spangs gnas su dag pa'i tshul: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul zhi ba'i sku: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar bar bzhugs: yab kyi cha 'dzin sa snying byams pa dkar: yum gyi cha 'dzin lā s+ya puṣ+pe ma: ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa'i gtso 'khor drug: yab yum sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ: gdod nas ma skyes ye nas rnam dag pa'i: kun bzang rig rtsal rdzogs pa'i cho 'phrul las: nga rgyal tshor ba rang grol mnyam nyid sku: ser gsal mdangs ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dpal: gsal stong 'dzin bral rin chen 'byung ldan shar: thabs shes gnyis med chu khams mā kir sbyor: rta mchog khri rkang nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : dug lnga ma spangs gnas su dag pa'i tshul: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon nu bum pa can: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar bar bzhugs: yab kyi cha 'dzin kun bzang nam snying dang : yum gyi cha 'dzin mā le dhu pe ma: ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa'i gtso 'khor drug: yab yum sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ: gdod nas ma skyes ye nas rnam dag pa'i: kun bzang rig rtsal rdzogs pa'i cho 'phrul las: 'dod chags 'du shes rang grol sor rtogs sku: dmar gsal mdangs ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dpal: bde stong 'dzin bral snang ba mtha' yas shar: thabs shes gnyis med me khams gos dkar sbyor: rma bya khri rkang nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : dug lnga ma spangs gnas su dag pa'i tshul: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon nu bum pa can: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar bar bzhugs: yab kyi cha 'dzin spyan gzigs 'jam dpal dang : yum gyi cha 'dzin gīrti ā lo ke: ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa'i gtso 'khor drug: yab yum sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ: gdod nas ma skyes ye nas rnam dag pa'i: kun bzang rig rtsal rdzogs pa'i cho 'phrul las:

phrag dog 'du byed rang grol bya grub sku: ljang gsal mdangs ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dpal: grags stong 'dzin bral don yod grub par shar: thabs shes gnyis med rlung khams sgrol mar sbyor: shang shang khri rkang nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : dug lnga ma spangs gnas su dag pa'i tshul: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon nu bum pa can: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar bar bzhugs: yab kyi cha 'dzin sgrib sel phyag rdor dang : yum gyi cha 'dzin gan+dhe nīrti ma: ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa'i gtso 'khor drug: yab yum sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ: gdod nas ma skyes ye nas rnam dag pa'i: kun bzang rig rtsal rdzogs pa'i cho 'phrul las: gti mug gzugs phung rang grol chos dbyings sku: dkar gsal mdangs ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dpal: dran stong 'dzin bral rnam par snang mdzad shar: thabs shes gnyis med nam mkha' dbyings phyug sbyor: seng chen khri rkang nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : dug lnga ma spangs gnas su dag pa'i tshul: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon nu bum pa can: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar bar bzhugs: rigs bzhi'i yab yum sems dpa' sems mar bcas: yab yum sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ: gdod nas ma skyes ye nas rnam dag pa'i: kun bzang rig rtsal rdzogs pa'i cho 'phrul las: nyon drug rang grol sprul sku thub drug shar: brgya byin thags bzang shākya thub pa dang : seng ge rab brtan kha 'bar chos kyi rgyal: rnam rgyal gshin rje dbang chen bdud rtsi 'khyil: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma: bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba thugs dam can: 'od kyi lus la ye shes snying po can: stong gsal mdangs lnga ldan la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pas gdung dbyangs snyan pos bstod par bya: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi don bstod chen mo'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: :t+ya/t+ya/t+ya/: bzhi pa khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad la:

don bstod chen mos gus par bstod pa ni: lag tu rnga chen thogs la rngams pa'i dbyangs: 'gyings dang ngar du ldan pas 'di skad do: hūm̐: snang srid gzhir bzhengs rang byung dkyil 'khor du: chos sku zhi ba'i rig rtsal cho 'phrul las: nyon mongs 'joms mdzad khrag 'thung he ru ka: mthu rtsal thogs med dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: thabs mchog sku la shes rab khro mo 'khril: rū tra pho mo rin chen khri rkang dang : byol song pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng : theg pa rim dgu rdzogs pa'i skur ston pa: sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang : rgod dang gshe dang 'jigs par ston pa dang : snying rje rngams dang zhi ba la sogs pa: bcom ldan dpal chen 'khor 'das rdzogs la bstod: hūm̐: snang srid gzhir bzhengs rang byung dkyil 'khor du: zhi ba longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cho 'phrul las: gti mug 'joms mdzad bud+dha he ru ka: bud+dha kro ti gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: byol song ru tra pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : gar gyi nyams dgu dur khrod chas brgyad dang : theg pa rim dgu rdzogs pa'i skur bstan pa: sku mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: snang srid gzhir bzhengs rang byung dkyil 'khor du: zhi ba longs sku'i thugs kyi cho 'phrul las: zhe sdang 'joms mdzad badz+ra he ru ka: badz+ra kro ti gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: byol song ru tra pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : gar gyi nyams dgu dur khrod chas brgyad dang : theg pa rim dgu rdzogs pa'i skur bstan pa: thugs mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: snang srid gzhir bzhengs rang byung dkyil 'khor du: zhi ba longs sku'i yon tan cho 'phrul las: nga rgyal 'joms mdzad rat+na he ru ka: rat+na kro ti gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: byol song ru tra pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : gar gyi nyams dgu dur khrod chas brgyad dang : theg pa rim dgu rdzogs pa'i skur bstan pa: yon tan he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod:

hūm̐: snang srid gzhir bzhengs rang byung dkyil 'khor du: zhi ba longs sku'i gsung gi cho 'phrul las: 'dod chags 'joms mdzad pad+ma he ru ka: pad+ma kro ti gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: byol song ru tra pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : gar gyi nyams dgu dur khrod chas brgyad dang : theg pa rim dgu rdzogs pa'i skur bstan pa: gsung mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: snang srid gzhir bzhengs rang byung dkyil 'khor du: zhi ba longs sku'i phrin las cho 'phrul las: phrag dog 'joms mdzad karma he ru ka: karma kro ti gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: byol song ru tra pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : gar gyi nyams dgu dur khrod chas brgyad dang : theg pa rim dgu rdzogs pa'i skur bstan pa: phrin las he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang : rgod dang gshe dang 'jigs par ston pa dang : snying rje rngams dang zhi ba gar dgur ldan: thal chen rak+ta zhag gi zo ris dang : ko rlon g.yang gzhi stag gi sham thabs dang : thod phreng sbrul chun me dpung chas dgus brgyan: gar gyi nyams dgu dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: khro bo'i cha lugs rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zhi ba longs sku'i rig rtsal cho 'phrul las: ha ha phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dkyil 'khor nas: thugs rje sprul pa'i cha 'dzin kau rī brgyad: rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag pa'i cho 'phrul las: kau rī tsau rī pra mo be ta li: puska ghasma sme sha tsan+ḍa li: sku mdog phyag mtshan cir yang ston cing bsgyur: phrin las kau rī brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: he he: shar lho nub byang phyogs mtshams dkyil 'khor nas: thugs rje sprul pa'i cha 'dzin sengha brgyad: rnam shes yul brgyad dag pa'i cho 'phrul las: sengha bya kri sri la shwa na ma: kṛ ta kaṅka kha khwa hu lu ma: sku mdog phyag mtshan mgo brnyan ston cing bsgyur: zhi rgyas dbang drag rang rtags phrin las rnams:

mdzad pa'i sengha brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: dzaḥhūm̐: shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi'i sgo bzhi nas: rta gdong phag gdong seng gdong sbrul gdong ma: snying rje byams pa dga' ba btang snyoms tshul: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma: 'gugs 'ching sdom dgyes rang rang phrin las kun: mdzad pa'i sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ dkar mo chen mo zhi ba'i las byed bdun: ser mo chen mo rgyas pa'i las byed bdun: dmar mo chen mo dbang gi las byed bdun: ljang mo chen mo drag po'i las byed bdun: sprul pa'i mgo brnyan phyag mtshan ston cing bsgyur: dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pa rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: bstod pa gzhan yang ci bder bstod na legs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas bcu gnyis pa bshags pa bya ba ni: gnong 'gyod drag po'i sems kyis 'di skad do: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bla ma kun bzang chos kyi sku: nyag gcig zang thal longs spyod rdzogs: shar grol 'gag med sprul pa'i sku: rgyal ba zhi khro sprul 'khor dgongs: bdag dang 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyis: gti mug 'khrul sems dpag med blangs pa nas: da lta tshe 'di'i lus blangs yan chad du: rig dang ma rig 'khrul pa'i las dbang gis: sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi: dam tshig chag nyams 'gal 'khrul gyur pa kun: mi gsang mi sbed gnong 'gyod mthol lo bshags: klong yangs chen po'i ngang du bzod par gsol: oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya: sogs nas satwa āḥ gzhan yang zhi khro'i lta ba'i klong bshags sogs: rgyas bsdus gang 'os skabs dang bstun la bshags: zhi khro 'dus pa'i las byang tshor ba rang grol gyi dngos gzhi'i las kyi rim pa : sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:

bcu gsum pa tshogs kyi las rim bcu yis bstan: bgegs bskrad bsang sbyangs spyan 'dren mchod bshags bsgral: zhal du bstab rol yar gnas mar gnas bcu: 'dod pa'i yo byad thams cad dngos su bshams: bsang chu 'thor zhing thog mar bgegs bskrad ni: hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: lus ngag sems la gnod byed pa'i: dug lnga dug gsum rnam rtog bgegs: nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'dre: khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'dre bo che: lan chags gnas 'dir ma 'dug par: nga yi bka' las khyod ma 'da': rang rang gnas su myur du dengs: hūm̐ hūm̐ u tsa ta ya phaṭaḥ gnyis pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpar gsal: sems dpa'i skur gsal thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor byin gyis brlab pa yi: oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing 'phros: zhal zas dngos po thams cad kun: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum ngo bor gyur: gzhan yang phyi nang snod bcud kyi: zhal zas bcud ldan ro mchog rnams: yi ge gsum gyi ngo bor gyur: yi ge gsum las me 'bar bas: tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin dri ma bsreg: me yi shugs las rlung byung bas: tshogs kyi bag chags rnam rtog gtor: me rlung 'thab pas chu byung bas: tshogs kyi gnyis 'dzin rnam rtog bkrus: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: me dang rlung dang chu dang gsum: 'od du ltem gyis zhu ba las: sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi ni: dkar dmar mthing ga gsum du gyur: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs: mnyes mchod bdud rtsi chen por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hrīḥha hoḥ gsum pa tshogs la spyan 'dren pa 'di skad do: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: chos sku kun tu bzang po la: rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dag pa dbyings kyi gzhal yas nas: yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la: so so'i rigs kyi tshogs kyis bskor:

tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtse mo nas: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la: rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: o rgyan rang byung dur khrod nas: mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo la: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas: bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho la: so so'i rigs kyi tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: de nas tshogs phud rim pa gsum du bcad byas nas: tshogs phud dang po mchod pa 'di skad do: hūm̐: bla ma kun bzang thig le'i sku: nyag gcig zang thal longs spyod rdzogs: cir mi dgongs pa sprul pa'i sku: rgyal ba rgya mtsho zhi khro'i tshogs: mkha' 'gro chos skyong sprul 'khor bcas: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: tshogs phud bar pa bshags pa 'di skad do: hūm̐: bdag cag 'khor ba'i sems gzhi blangs pa nas: tha ma da lta'i dus 'di yan chad du: rig dang ma rig bag chags dbang gyur pas: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa rnams: zhal zas tshogs 'bul bskang zhing bshags par bgyi: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs par stsal du gsol: yi ge brgya pa na raka la sogs 'don: skabs 'dir zhi khro'i mdangs bskang la sogs dang : bskang bshags gzhan yang ci rigs bklag par bya: tshogs phud tha ma bsgral zhing bstab pa ni: tshogs zan nya bo hom khung nang du bcug: bdag nyid che mchog skur gsal bden stobs brjod: dgug gzhug lan gsum rjes la 'di skad do: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs pa zhi khro'i tshogs: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang : gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs rdzogs mdzad pa: drag po'i phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab: mi mngon dbyings nas bdag gi grogs la byon: dang po bla srog rten la bkug pa ni:

hūm̐: khrag 'thung sku yi lha tshogs thugs dam can: drag po'i phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab: yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan rnams: bla srog rnam shes rten la myur du khug: oṃ bud+dha kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dgra bgegs nṛ tri aṃ ku sha dzaḥ hoḥ dpal chen po bud+dha he ru ka'i lha tshogs rnams kyis yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan 'di rnams skad cig nyid la myur du khug cig: gnyis pa lha dang phral ba ni: hūm̐: khrag 'thung thugs kyi lha tshogs thugs dam can: drag po'i phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab: yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan rnams: mgon skyabs byed pa'i lha dang phral bar gyis: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ a nṛ tri trag rak+ṣa ma ra ya phyes: ma ma trag ru tra mā ra ya phyes: hoḥ dpal chen po badz+ra he ru ka'i lha tshogs rnams kyis yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan 'di mgon skyabs byed pa'i lha dang phral bar gyis shig: gsum pa byad du bcug pa ni: hūm̐: khrag 'thung yon tan lha tshogs thugs dam can: drag po'i phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan 'di: lus ngag yid gsum gru gu thul du chings: oṃ rat+na kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dgra bgegs nṛ tri a pa na ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hoḥ dpal chen po rat+na he ru ka'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs 'di'i lus ngag yid gsum gru gu thul du byad du chug cig: bzhi pa gtun du brdung ba ni: hūm̐: khrag 'thung gsung gi lha tshogs thugs dam can: drag po'i phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan 'di: lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gyis: oṃ pad+ma kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dgra bgegs ta thā ya ta thā ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hoḥ dpal chen po pad+ma he ru ka'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan 'di rnams rdo rje'i tho bas rdul du brlag par gyis shig:

lnga pa smyo ru gzhug pa ni: hūm̐: khrag 'thung phrin las lha tshogs thugs dam can: drag po'i phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan 'di: lus ngag yid gsum smyo zhing brgyal du chug: oṃ karma kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dgra bgegs dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hoḥ dpal chen po karma he ru ka'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan 'di rnams smyo zhing brgyal nas reng du chug cig: drug pa pho nya bskul zhing bsgral ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ phog par rgyob cig ma mo kau rī ma: snying nas gzir cig ma mo tsau rī ma: dbang du sdus shig ma mo pra mo ha: glo snying phyungs shig ma mo be ta lī: rgyu zhags drongs shig ma mo puska si: snying khrag 'thung zhig ma mo ghasma ri: tsit+ta phyungs shig ma mo sme sha ni: mgo lus phrol cig ma mo tsaṇ+ḍā li: sha la rol cig phra men sengha ma: rus pa 'chos shig phra men bya kri ma: lpags rlon bshus shig phra men sri la ma: sha la rol cig phra men shwa na ma: klad khrag 'thung zhig phra men kṛ ta ma: nang rol zo zhig phra men kaṅka ma: mig tshil brus shig phra men kha khwa ma: glo snying zo zhig phra men hu lu ma: snying nas drongs shig rta gdong lcags kyu ma: mgul nas chings shig phag gdong zhags pa ma: yan lag sdoms shig seng gdong lcags sgrog ma: rdul du rlogs shig sbrul gdong dril bu ma: sha khrag don snying nang rol ma lus pa: dpal chen zhal du stobs shig dbang phyug rnams: zhes pas nya bo'i phung po bsgral bar bya: bdun pa nya bo'i phung po zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐: dang po'i sangs rgyas kun bzang yab yum la: dam nyams bsgral ba'i yid chos mchod par 'bul: zhi ba longs sku'i sangs rgyas rigs lnga la: dgra bo'i phung po rnam lnga mchod pa 'bul: gsang ba'i bde ster yum mchog lnga po la: dgra bo'i sha khrag 'byung lnga'i mchod pa 'bul:

nye ba'i sras mchog sems dpa' brgyad rnams la: dgra bgegs rnam shes tshogs brgyad mchod pa 'bul: gsang ba'i lha mo sems ma brgyad rnams la: dgra bgegs dbang po yul brgyad mchod pa 'bul: sprul pa'i sgo ba yab yum brgyad rnams la: yan lag nywa bzhi tshigs bzhi'i mchod pa 'bul: sprul pa'i sku mchog thub pa drug rnams la: rnam shes dbang po tshogs drug mchod pa 'bul: hūm̐: bcom ldan khrag 'thung che mchog yab yum la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i nyon mongs zhal du bstab: sprul pa'i khrag 'thung rigs lnga yab yum la: dgra bgegs dug lnga phung lnga zhal du bstab: gnas kyi kau rī ma mo brgyad rnams la: dgra bgegs don snying nang rol zhal du bstab: yul gyi sengha phra men brgyad rnams la: dgra bgegs phyi sha lhu tshigs zhal du bstab: rta gdong ye shes sgo ma bzhi rnams la: dgra bgegs yan lag rnam bzhi zhal du bstab: dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad la: sgal tshigs nyi shu rtsa brgyad zhal du bstab: gzhan yang bka' yi srung ma thams cad la: sha rus lpags pa rtsa rgyus la sogs pa: phung po lhag ma med par zhal du bstab: bstab bo bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi: khyed kyi thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur nas: bdag la tshe dbang longs spyod dngos grub stsol: rnal 'byor 'khor dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod: dgra bgegs rnam shes bde gshegs sras gyur cig: dgra bgegs dam sri'i ma hā māṃ sa la khā hiḥ ma hā rak+ta la khā hiḥ ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hiḥ ma hā ba su ta la khā hiḥ ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hiḥ ma hā tsit+ta la khā hiḥ ces pas phung po gtor mar bstab par bya: brgyad pa rnal 'byor pho mo tshogs la rol: las kyis slob bus tshogs btegs la 'di skad do: hoḥ rnal 'byor pho mo mched dang lcam dral rnams: zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs rang bzhin sku: dga' ldan lha yi tshogs mchod dpag tu med: 'phrul dga' lha yi ting 'dzin yid kyis sprul:

tshogs mchod dag pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'di: dgyes pa mchog gi longs spyod rnam par rol: a la la hoḥ bla mas pad bskor phyag rgyas 'di skad blangs: hoḥ sku rdo rje mi 'gyur ba'i dngos grub: gsung rdo rje mi 'gag pa'i dngos grub: thugs rdo rje spros bral gyi dngos grub: sku gsung thugs rdo rje mi 'gyur ba'i dngos grub dam pa a la la hoḥ zhes pas rnal 'byor mched lcam du yod kun: che chung pham rgyal med par rol par bya: de nas tshogs kyi lhag ma'i mchod pa ni: yar gnas mar gnas rnam pa gnyis su bstan: dgu pa yar gnas gtsang lhag gtor mar bstab: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med nam mkha'i rang bzhin la: longs sku 'gag med bde gshegs zhi khro'i tshogs: tshogs phud dgyes pa chen pos yar bzhes la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: hūm̐: dang po gtsang ma phud kyis mi mchod rgyu: rgyal ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis phud la dgyes: bar du bcud ldan tshogs la mi rol rgyu: khrag 'thung 'bar ba'i tshogs kyang tshogs la dgyes: tha ma tshogs kyi lhag mas mi brngan rgyu: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad lhag la dgyes: phud la dgyes pa'i bde gshegs phud la rol: tshogs la dgyes pa'i khrag 'thung tshogs la rol: lhag la dgyes pa'i bran mo lhag la rol: so so'i thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: de nas phud dang lhag ma bsres la: hūm̐: bar du gnyis med gcig tu mi bsrai rgyu: chos dbyings rnam dag ye nas rgyu 'bras gcig: de nas tshogs lhag kha phrus btab pa ni: hūm̐: tha ma lhag mar kha chus mi 'debs rgyu: khyod dang nga gnyis rdo rje'i tha tshig gcig: sngon tshe dpal chen khrag 'thung spyan snga ru: dbus la mi 'tshal dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong : phud la mi 'tshal lhag ma'i zhal chab zhu: ci bgyi'i bka' nyan bsgrub ces khas blangs bzhin: lhag ma'i bshal chu gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khas blangs dam bcas bzhin du phrin las mdzod:

bcu pa lhag ma mar gnas bskul ba ni: bh+yoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i lhag sdud ma: shar nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdun: sku mdog dkar nag mgo brnyan cir yang ston: gnas bzang dur khrod nyul zhing tshogs khang 'grim: gos bzang g.yang gzhi gon nas bhan+dha thogs: skom bzang rak+ta 'thung zhing ro la za: dam tshig srung mar rgyu zhing mkha' la 'gro: zas su nyams pa'i sha dang khrag la dgyes: las su dgra bgegs gsod dang gcod la brtson: lhag gtor bzhes la phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i lhag sdud ma: lho nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdun: sku mdog ser nag mgo brnyan cir yang ston: gnas bzang dur khrod nyul zhing tshogs khang 'grim: gos bzang g.yang gzhi gon nas bhan+dha thogs: skom bzang rak+ta 'thung zhing ro la za: dam tshig srung mar rgyu zhing mkha' la 'gro: zas su nyams pa'i sha dang khrag la dgyes: las su dgra bgegs gsod dang gcod la brtson: lhag gtor bzhes la phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i lhag sdud ma: nub nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdun: sku mdog dmar nag mgo brnyan cir yang ston: gnas bzang dur khrod nyul zhing tshogs khang 'grim: gos bzang g.yang gzhi gon nas bhan+dha thogs: skom bzang rak+ta 'thung zhing ro la za: dam tshig srung mar rgyu zhing mkha' la 'gro: zas su nyams pa'i sha dang khrag la dgyes: las su dgra bgegs gsod dang gcod la brtson: lhag gtor bzhes la phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i lhag sdud ma: byang nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdun: sku mdog ljang nag mgo brnyan cir yang ston: gnas bzang dur khrod nyul zhing tshogs khang 'grim: gos bzang g.yang gzhi gon nas bhan+dha thogs: skom bzang rak+ta 'thung zhing ro la za: dam tshig srung mar rgyu zhing mkha' la 'gro: zas su nyams pa'i sha dang khrag la dgyes:

las su dgra bgegs gsod dang gcod la brtson: lhag gtor bzhes la phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces pas lhag ma'i gtor ma bskul bar bya'o: zhi khro 'dus pa'i tshogs mchod las rim 'di: skal ldan skyes bu rnams kyis brtson par gyis: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas bcu bzhi pa thugs dam bskul ba ni: rnam pa gsum ste zhi khro pho nya gsum: dang po zhi ba bzhi bcu'i spyi bskul ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ rnam dag chos dbyings khyab brdal klong yangs nas: kun bzang che mchog rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: mi mngon dbyings nas skur bzhengs 'dir gshegs la: log 'dren sems can 'dul ba'i grogs la byon: hūm̐: zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang nas: rgyal ba kun gyi spyi myes kun tu bzang : rgyal ba'i bskyed yum chos nyid bzang mo yum: gnyis med rol pa'i lcam dral byung ba ni: rnam snang rdo rje sems dpa' rin chen 'byung : snang mtha' don yod grub pa rigs lnga yab: dbyings phyug sangs rgyas spyan dang mā ma kī: gos dkar sgrol ma la sogs yum mchog lnga : thog ma'i dus kyi thugs dam nyer dgongs la: mi mngon dbyings nas sems can don la byon: hūm̐: gnyis med sprul pa'i sems dpa' lcam dral ni: sa snying byams pa kun bzang nam mkha'i snying : spyan gzigs 'jam dpal sgrib sel phyag rdor brgyad: lā s+ya puṣ+pe mā le dhu pe ma: girti ā lo ghan+dhe nirti brgyad: sems dpa' yab yum lcam dral bcu drug kyang : thog ma'i dus kyi thugs dam nyer dgongs la: mi mngon dbyings nas sems can don la byon: hūm̐: gnyis med rol pa'i 'gro 'dul sprul sku drug: brgya byin thag bzang shāka thub seng ge brtan: kha 'bar chos rgyal rigs drug 'dul mdzad drug: 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i thub chen drug po yang : thog ma'i dus kyi thugs dam nyer dgongs la: mi mngon dbyings nas 'gro drug don la byon: hūm̐:

gnyis med rol pa'i sgo srung yab yum brgyad: rnam rgyal gshin rje rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'khrol ma: 'gugs 'ching sdom dgyes las mdzad sgo ma rnams: thog ma'i dus kyi thugs dam nyer dgongs la: mi mngon dbyings nas bdag gi grogs la byon: khyed kyi bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar zhing : ma rungs snyigs ma'i sems can 'dul dka' bas: khyod kyi dam bcas dus 'dir ma dgongs na: bstan pa'i ru tra yan par shor ta re: 'gro ba sems can ngan 'gror ltung ta re: rgyal ba'i bstan pa nub par 'gyur ta re: yab yum sras dang bka' sdod srung mar bcas: so so'i thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: gnyis pa khrag 'thung drug cu'i spyi bskul ni: hūm̐ hūm̐: chos sku zhi ba'i rig rtsal cho 'phrul las: nyon mongs gdug pa 'dul ba'i khrag 'thung 'phros: bh+yoḥ khrag 'thung rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: khro rgyal rje btsan che mchog he ru ka: gnyis med yum chen dbyings phyug khro mo 'khril: 'khril sbyor rol pa'i khrag 'thung byung ba ni: bud+dha badz+ra rat+na pad+ma dang : karma he ru ka sogs khrag 'thung lnga : sangs rgyas rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : las kyi dbyings phyug la sogs kro ti lnga : khyod kyi bstan la gdug pa'i dgra dar bas: drag po khros pa'i tshul gyis grogs la byon: hūm̐ hāḥ gnyis med rol pa'i ma mo sprul pa ni: kau rī tsau rī pra mo be ta lī: puska ghasma sme sha tsaṇ+ḍā li: gnas kyi kau rī ma mo brgyad rnams kyang : sangs rgyas bstan la sdang ba'i dgra dar bas: za byed rngams pa'i tshul gyis grogs la byon: hūm̐ heḥ gnyis med rol pa'i phra men sprul pa ni: sengha bya kri sri la shwa na ma: kri ta kaṅka kha khwa hu lu ma: yul gyi sengha phra men brgyad rnams kyang : bstan pa gnyan la sdang ba'i dgra dar bas: gsod byed 'jigs pa'i tshul gyis grogs la byon:

hūm̐ dzaḥ gnyis med rol pa'i sgo srung sprul pa ni: rta gdong phag gdong seng gdong sbrul gdong bzhi: 'gug 'ching sdom dgyes phrin las bzhi mdzad ma: bstan pa gnyan la sdang ba'i dgra dar bas: yab yum sras dang bka' sdod sprul 'khor bcas: sgrol byed 'khyug pa'i tshul gyis grogs la byon: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ gnyis med rol pa'i yang sprul pho nya ni: shar nas zhi ba'i las mdzad dbang phyug bdun: lho nas rgyas pa'i las mdzad dbang phyug bdun: nub nas dbang gi las mdzad dbang phyug bdun: byang nas drag po'i las mdzad dbang phyug bdun: sprul pa'i mgo brnyan rdzu 'phrul cir yang ston: bka' yi bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i: myur mgyogs mthu dang rdzu 'phrul ldan pa rnams: bstan pa gnyan la sdang ba'i dgra dar bas: dgra bgegs bsgral phyir bdag gi grogs la byon: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ zhi khro rigs brgya'i bka' nyan las byed rnams: sngon tshe spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: deng 'dir khyod kyi bstan pa nub la nye: bstan pa gnyan la sdang ba'i dgra dar bas: yab yum sras dang bka' sdod sprul 'khor bcas: khyod kyi thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la babs: myur zhing rings pa'i tshul gyis 'dir gshegs la: bstan pa'i dgra bgegs brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: mi mthun rkyen tshogs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: bcol ba'i phrin las myur mgyogs 'grub par mdzod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa pho nya sgos su bskul ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bka' dang dam tshig gzhal yas su: zhi khro'i sprul pa yang sprul dang : bka' nyan las byed srung ma'i tshogs: la las bstan pa'i gzhi 'dzin mdzad: la las bka' yi bya ra mdzad: la las chos mdzad srung ma mdzad: la las gtsug lag dkor khang srung : la las yul dgon dben gnas srung : la las dam tshig las rjes gcod: la las sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzad: la las stong gsum khyab par nyul: la la bsam gtan ngang la gnas: la las skye 'gro'i bla tshe rku:

la la srog gcod srin po'i rigs: la la gtsang sbra bram ze'i rigs: la la rims dang nad kyi bdag: la la ltas ngan cho 'phrul bdag: sprul pa yang sprul bsam mi khyab: 'khor dang las byed bye ba 'bum: kun kyang zhi khro'i cho 'phrul te: rig rtsal rol pa thogs med 'phro: khyed cag sngon gyi tha tshig can: rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin: da lta bstan la dgra dar bas: ma g.yel bka' yi srung ma rnams: rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs rnams: yud tsam gyis ni brlag par mdzod: sa ma ya: gra ma/ga:t+ya/t+ya/t+ya/:

bco lnga bka' yi chad mdo 'di skad do: hūm̐: dus gsum dus med ka dag dus kyi tshe: rnam dag chos dbyings khyab brdal klong yangs su: kun tu bzang po grol gzhi'i dus kyi tshe: thog ma'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur ba yis: ma bcos rang shar rang dam bcas pa bzhin: 'khor 'das gzhi nas grol bar ma chad dam: 'khrul pa ka nas dag par ma chad dam: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par ma chad dam: ye grol gshis kyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: kun gzhi klong du grol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: rnam dag 'og min chos dbyings pho brang du: thog ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po yis: rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' lcam dral la: chos sku'i dgongs pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe: zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs thams cad kyis: so so'i sku gsung thugs su bstan nas kyang : phung khams gnas su dag par ma chad dam: rigs drug dbyings su sgrol bar ma chad dam: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par ma chad dam: rtog tshogs rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ci ltar khas blangs dam bcas de bzhin du: 'khor ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa'i dbus ma la: 'og min gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: kun tu bzang po che mchog he ru ka: khrag 'thung rigs lnga zhi khro sprul 'khor gyis: dregs pa ru tra'i sde dpon btul ba'i tshe: dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang : dregs pa can gyi 'khor tshogs thams cad kyis: rang rang srog gi snying po phul nas kyang : bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: rnal 'byor sku tshe bsring bar ma chad dam: rgyu sbyor rkyen ngan bzlog par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: gtor ma 'di bzhes phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa'i phyi ma la: bod yul kha ba can gyi yul ljongs su:

slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas bzhengs pa'i tshe: bod kyi lha srin dregs pa thams cad kyis: rang rang srog gi snying po phul nas kyang : bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: rnal 'byor sku tshe bsring bar ma chad dam: rgyu sbyor rkyen ngan bzlog par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: gtor ma 'di bzhes phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og bskal pa phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : shes rab yum chen mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal gyis: zab chos mtha' dag gter du sbas pa'i tshe: gter bdag chos kyi srung ma thams cad dang : dregs pa sde brgyad brtan ma bcu gnyis kyis: rang rang srog gi snying po phul nas kyang : bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: rnal 'byor sku tshe bsring bar ma chad dam: rgyu sbyor rkyen ngan bzlog par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: gtor ma 'di bzhes phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: da dus snyigs ma'i dus la bab pa'i tshe: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: sprul pa yang sprul sum sprul bkyes nas su: zab chos mtha' dag gter nas bton pa'i tshe: srung ma dam can rgya mtsho thams cad dang : gsang sngags chos kyi srung ma thams cad kyis: rang rang srog gi snying po phul nas kyang : bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: rnal 'byor sku tshe bsring bar ma chad dam: rgyu sbyor rkyen ngan bzlog par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: gtor ma 'di bzhes phrin las 'grub par mdzod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bcu drug pa sgo dbye bya ba 'di skad do: hūm̐ dzaḥ shar phyogs sgo ma rta gdong ma: snying rje tshad med lcags kyu yis: me long ye shes shar sgo phyes:

zhe sdang dgra bgegs tshar chod la: 'jigs pa brgyad sogs zhi ba dang : gtor ma'i zor lam dgra la bsgyur: hūm̐ hūm̐: lho phyogs sgo ma phag gdong ma: byams pa tshad med zhags pa yis: mnyam nyid ye shes lho sgo phyes: nga rgyal dgra bgegs tshar chod la: bsod nams ye shes rgyas pa dang : gtor ma'i zor lam dgra la bsgyur: hūm̐ bam̐: nub phyogs sgo ma seng gdong ma: dga' ba tshad med lcags sgrog gis: sor rtogs ye shes nub sgo phyes: 'dod chags dgra bgegs tshar chod la: khams gsum dbang du sdud pa dang : gtor ma'i zor lam dgra la bsgyur: hūm̐ hoḥ byang phyogs sgo ma sbrul gdong ma: btang snyoms tshad med dril bu yis: bya grub ye shes byang sgo phyes: phrag dog dgra bgegs tshar chod la: mi mthun rkyen ngan dgra la bzlog: gtor ma'i zor lam dgra la bsgyur: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og bcu: de na phyogs skyong bcu po bzhugs: phyogs skyong pho rnams khrag tu skyug: phyogs skyong mo rnams 'bog cing brgyal: phyogs skyong phru gu dmyal thag gcod: der yang snying rjes zor mi 'phen: zor 'phen sdang ba'i dgra la 'phen: zor 'phen gnod pa'i bgegs la 'phen: dgra dpung bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: bgegs dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlogs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bcu bdun pa gtor skyong bya ba 'di skad do: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bstan pa skyong mdzad ma sring tshogs: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang : 'dzam gling brtan ma bcu gnyis rnams: 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma longs: shar nas zhi ba'i las byed bdun: 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma longs: dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: lho nas rgyas pa'i las byed bdun: 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma longs: bsod nams rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: nub nas dbang gi las byed bdun: 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma longs: 'khor 'das dbang sdud phrin las mdzod:

byang nas drag po'i las byed bdun: 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma longs: dgra bgegs tshar gcod phrin las mdzod: bod khams brtan ma bcu gnyis dang : g.ya' ma skyong ma'i tshogs rnams kyang : bshal chu'i gtor ma 'di longs la: sngon tshe rgyal ba zhi khro'i bka': de rjes slob dpon pad+ma'i bka': da lta rnal 'byor bdag gi bka': bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar: gtor ma 'di bzhes phrin las mdzod: slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga ru: ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: dam tshig 'di las khyod ma 'da': dam tshig 'di las khyod 'das na: rdo rje khro bo gnod sbyin gyis: snying khrag 'thung nas brlag par byed: de bas dam las ma 'da' bar: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas bco brgyad pa gtor bro brdung ba ni: mched lcam zhi khro khrag 'thung skur bsgom zhing : lag pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud du sbrel: ma rig nyon mongs dgra bgegs ma lus pa: dgug gzhug thar med gnas su mnan par bsam: gtor gzhong kha sbubs de steng 'di skad do: hūm̐: phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i steng phyogs nas: gti mug 'joms pa'i chos dbyings ye shes gsal: mthing gsal sgyu ma'i lha dang lha mos bskor: dbus phyogs bde gshegs rigs kyis bro brdungs pas: gti mug mgo la 'od gsal chems se chem: bro yang chos dbyings ye shes chen po'i bro: glu yang chos dbyings ye shes chen po'i glu: chos dbyings ye shes glu blangs bro brdungs pas: rnam rtog mtshan ma'i dgra bgegs rang sar grol: hūm̐: phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i shar phyogs nas: zhe sdang 'joms pa'i me long ye shes gsal: dkar gsal sgyu ma'i lha dang lha mos bskor: shar phyogs rdo rje rigs kyis bro brdungs pas: zhe sdang mgo la rang grol chems se chem: bro yang me long ye shes chen po'i bro: glu yang me long ye shes chen po'i glu: me long ye shes glu blangs bro brdungs pas:

zhe sdang mtshan ma'i dgra bgegs rang sar grol: hūm̐: phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i lho phyogs nas: nga rgyal 'joms pa'i mnyam nyid ye shes gsal: ser gsal sgyu ma'i lha dang lha mos bskor: lho phyogs rin chen rigs kyis bro brdungs pas: nga rgyal mgo la gsal stong chems se chem: bro yang mnyam nyid ye shes chen po'i bro: glu yang mnyam nyid ye shes chen po'i glu: mnyam nyid ye shes glu blangs bro brdungs pas: nga rgyal mtshan ma'i dgra bgegs rang sar grol: hūm̐: phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i nub phyogs nas: 'dod chags 'joms pa'i sor rtogs ye shes gsal: dmar gsal sgyu ma'i lha dang lha mos bskor: nub phyogs pad+ma rigs kyi bro brdungs pas: 'dod chags mgo la bde stong chems se chem: bro yang sor rtogs ye shes chen po'i bro: glu yang sor rtogs ye shes chen po'i glu: sor rtogs ye shes glu blangs bro brdungs pas: 'dod chags mtshan ma'i dgra bgegs rang sar grol: hūm̐: phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i byang phyogs nas: phrag dog 'joms pa'i bya grub ye shes gsal: ljang gsal sgyu ma'i lha dang lha mos bskor: byang phyogs las kyi rigs kyi bro brdungs pas: phrag dog mgo la grags stong chems se chem: bro yang bya grub ye shes chen po'i bro: glu yang bya grub ye shes chen po'i glu: bya grub ye shes glu blangs bro brdungs pas: phrag dog mtshan ma'i dgra bgegs rang sar grol: oṃ laṃ: āḥlaṃ: hūm̐ laṃ: hrīḥlaṃ: swā laṃ: s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: sarba sha truṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: rgya rgya rgya: de nas nang du log nas bkra shis dang : bsngo ba smon lam rjes kyi las rim ni: dang po bshags pa bzod gsol bskang ba ni: bdag nyid spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan steng du: dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' shel gyi mdog: rdo rje dril 'dzin phyed skyil bzhugs pa yi: thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ la yig brgyas bskor:

bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs nyams chag sdig sgrib kun: ma lus dag nas shel sgong lta bur gyur: oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya: nas ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ a ā: i ī: u ū: ṛ ṝ: l̥ l̥̄: e ai: o au: aṃ āḥ ka kha ga gha nga : tsa tsha dza dzha nya: ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa: ta tha da dha na: pa pha ba bha ma: ya ra la wa: sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa: kun gzhi ma bcos klong yangs ngang nyid las: rang rig gsal stong ye nas kun tu bzang : gdod nas ma skyes bde chen kun bzang mo: dbyer med ma bcos bde ba chen po la: bskang dang bshags pa'i yul las ye nas 'das: 'di ltar rtogs na bskang bshags mchog tu 'gyur: de nas lha la bzod par gsol ba ni: gang yang bdag blo ma rig gti mug pas: ye nas ka dag chen po'i rang bzhin la: de ltar ma rtogs gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa yis: cho ga lhag chad nor 'khrul gyur pa kun: klong yangs chen po'i ngang du bzod par gsol: tshangs par mdzad nas dngos grub stsal du gsol: gnyis pa bkra shis brjod pa 'di skad do: oṃ: stong zhing bdag med ka dag lhun gyis grub: kun tu bzang po'i bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: āḥ gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'od zer 'phro: rigs lnga yab yum bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: hūm̐: thugs rje'i rgyun gyis rigs drug gnas nas 'dren: sprul sku thub drug bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: hrīḥ stong nyid snying rjes 'khor ba'i 'gro ba skyobs: sems dpa' sems ma'i bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: dzaḥ phrin las rnam bzhis gdul bya'i re ba skong : sgo ba sgo ma'i bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: hūm̐: sna tshogs thabs kyis log 'dren gdug pa 'dul: khrag 'thung lnga bcu'i bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog:

hrīḥ skye 'chi med pa tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: āḥ mthong thos dran reg skad cig sangs rgyas thob: dgongs pa rang grol bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: gzhi yi bkra shis rang rgyud 'dul bar shog: lam gyi bkra shis gzhan rgyud sbyong bar shog: 'bras bu'i bkra shis gzhi thog smin par shog: dmigs med mtha' bral lta ba'i bkra shis shog: yengs med rkyen thub sgom pa'i bkra shis shog: phyogs med rnam rgyal spyod pa'i bkra shis shog: sku gsum lhun grub 'bras bu'i bkra shis shog: gsum pa bsngo ba smon lam gdab pa ni: na mo: 'khor gsum yongs dag rab dkar dge ba 'dis: khams gsum rigs drug sems can ma lus pa: kun tu bzang po'i gzhi thog grol bar shog: longs sku zhi khro'i go 'phang thob par shog: sprul sku thub drug gdul bya rdzogs par shog: sku gsum 'bras bu myur du smin par shog: bzhi pa lha tshogs gshegs su gsol ba ni: oṃ: khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzod: rtogs pa mngon gyur dngos grub stsol: don la gshegs bzhud mi mnga' yang : chos dbyings klong du gshegs nas kyang : 'gro ba sems can don slad du: bdag gis spyan 'dren gsol 'debs dus: chos sku'i dbyings nas skur bzhengs la: slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: oṃ badz+ra muḥ rjes su rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ni: gzugs snang thams cad zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: lha tshogs nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar: snang stong gnyis med mtha' bral ngang la bzhag: sgra grags thams cad zhi khro'i lha tshogs gsung : grags stong nam mkha'i 'brug sgra yal ba ltar: grags stong brjod med ngang la mnyam par bzhag: dran bsam thams cad zhi khro'i thugs su shar: shar grol klong thim mkha' la sprin dengs ltar: thugs dgongs ma bcos skye med ngang la bzhag:

bsam du med de sems nyid nam mkha' che: brjod du med de rnam shes gzugs dang bral: a a a: de nas spyod lam rnam bzhi'i rjes thob dus: skad cig stong gsal chen po'i ngang nyid las: rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal ma bral bar: snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas spyod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: th+yath+yath+ya: zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: zhi khro 'dus pa'i las byang rtsa phreng tshor ba rang grol zhes bya ba: o rgyan gyi mkhan po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis sbyar ba: 'khor ba ma stongs bar du chos 'di ma rdzogs so: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: 'phrad nas 'gro ba ma lus 'dren par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: grub thob karma gling pa'i gter ma sūr+ya tsan+d+ra rasmi la bka' babs pa'i zab chos lags so:
